reason: The v0.1 design records panel and role digests that cannot be regenerated from its own documented deterministic hash rule, while no development or confirmatory genetic response has been opened. The panel membership lists were not persisted. This correction therefore gives authority to the already-published pre-response selection rule rather than to irreproducible digest-only memberships.

canonical_selection.panel_key: SHA256(panel_namespace + '|' + archive_sha256 + '|' + species), hexadecimal ascending; species name ascending as tie-break
canonical_selection.role_key: SHA256(role_namespace + '|' + archive_sha256 + '|' + species), hexadecimal ascending; species name ascending as tie-break
canonical_selection.digest_definition: SHA256 of species names sorted lexicographically and joined by one LF byte, with no trailing LF

corrected_information_gate.timing: evaluate only after this rule is committed; uses geography/taxonomy/sampling only

correction_result_policy.if_pass: freeze corrected species/role digests and response-blind G information as v0.2 and continue to the already-frozen fixed-T_st development screen
correction_result_policy.if_fail: close this codistributed-recurrence study as not evaluable; do not recover the old irreproducible membership by search or optimize another split

forbidden: inspect nucleotide identities, pairwise genetic distances, empirical T_st or empirical beta_G before corrected pre-response gates pass
choose among multiple panel hashes using G_st information
alter panel namespace, role namespaces, panel sizes or role sizes after the corrected information audit is computed
use the v0.1 TTF-Q values as evidence for the corrected membership
treat this provenance correction as a biological result
